shared_elements: incised/carved linear bands framing the field
small isolated motifs set within a plain panel
justification: Both are weathered stone monuments whose decoration is organised into stacked vertical zones bounded by linear bands, and both include a ring/disc motif and groups of parallel vertical strokes within an otherwise plain field. The decisive difference is medium and manner: A is a thin flat slab with faint, shallow, almost engraved outlines forming a rectangular frame, whereas B is a massive three-dimensional block carved into an anthropomorphic form with bold raised relief, so the placement and rendering correspond only in the loosest, most generic way.
